text:
zoe: Posting follow-ups from the Delta surge postmortem. Root cause: asymmetric NAT + intermittent BGP flap caused TCP reordering and large gRPC frames to drop, which cascaded into connection eviction and partial tenant isolation in dedicated pools.

mark: Can you break into concrete action items and owners?

zoe: Yep. Short list: infra filtering + canary, runtime defensive drain + PMTU probes, regression harness, customer coordination, and a monthly incident-pattern scan. Created tickets INF-5100..INF-5104.

mark: I'll take INF-5100 (infra). Plan: add stricter prefix filters, prefer ESTABLISHED packets, and add a small TCP health probe on peered endpoints. PR target Mon EOD, canary Tue 02:00-03:30 UTC on 5% prefixes. Need rollback plan.

infra-bot: ticket INF-5100 created by mark.

devex: I'll own INF-5101 (harness). I'll simulate asymmetric SNAT + BGP flaps and PMTU blackholes; will add nightly regression. Demo Thu.

zoe: INF-5102 runtime -> owner mark-runtime? mark, will you or should I assign to kevin-runtime?

mark: I'll pair with runtime folks and own delivery. Runtime changes: graceful connection quiesce on peer-change, staggered recon attempts, and active PMTU probes when large frames are used. Prototype Wed.

zoe: Success criteria to add to tickets: (1) synthetic flap test shows zero tenant isolation for 10m; (2) eviction rate <= 2e-4 during canary; (3) regression added to nightly CI.

mark: Infra snippet for PR description (will gate behind allowlist during canary):

```bash
# prefer established, drop unexpected from peer CIDR
iptables -A INPUT -s <peer-cidr> -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -s <peer-cidr> -j DROP
```

mark: We'll only enable DROP after canary pass and with a documented rollback.

devex: For the harness I'll include a log matcher that checks per-tenant eviction spikes and a replayable scenario for CI. Will add a failing test first.

zoe: Customer comms INF-5103 -> I'll draft a short note recommending NAT PMTU validation and a maintenance window for their edge team. Target send Tue EOD.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor canary and provide quick rollback if evictions spike. Add a Kibana saved query to PR: 

kql: message:eviction AND tenant_id:* AND timestamp:[now-30m TO now]

zoe: Also adding INF-5104 monthly-scan to detect recurring peering/MTU/isolation signals across customers. Suggest owner: SRE ops.

mark: Timeline recap:
- INF-5101 harness -> Thu demo, CI Fri
- INF-5102 runtime -> prototype Wed, PR Mon
- INF-5100 infra -> PR Mon EOD, canary Tue 02:00-03:30 UTC
- INF-5103 comms -> Tue EOD

zoe: I'll create sprint cards and calendar invite for the handoff meeting Wed 11am PT. If anyone needs to reassign, reply here. :thumbsup:
